scope: Two complementary family turnaround sheets of selected B04; not alternative designs. Original B04 remains primary, start with ELITE; VHEAVY remains provisional.
user_direction_exact: обнови так же арты семейства bw_elite. чтобы были со всех стороны - то есть сзади тоже. на выбранном арте
gallery_title: BW B04 — семейство со всех сторон
gallery_intro: Два дополняющих листа выбранного B04. Передняя перспектива, профиль и верх; задняя перспектива, прямой задний вид и низ. ELITE остаётся основным, VHEAVY — эскизным.

variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / identity-preserving spacecraft turnaround.
Extend the user's SELECTED B04 Border World pirate fighter family into coordinated all-angle reference sheets. This is ONE EXISTING family, not alternative designs. Show all THREE members together in three clearly separated horizontal rows: FIGHTER, ELITE, VHEAVY. Keep the selected B04 construction, proportions, silhouettes, stepped wing-root saddles, body cutouts, stepped trailing edges, long spear nose, recessed grilles, pale weathered metal and muted ochre/orange donor panels. Do not import Rheinland circular drums, Liberty collars/Art Deco, new fins, hoses, thin decorative framework, spikes or dense greebles.

IMMUTABLE COCKPIT for ALL THREE: use the ACTUAL source module, original proportions and location. One long central blue pane runs UP the sloping cabin crown and remains visible from above, plus two sloping side panes. Exactly three panes in the original outlines shown by cabin references. No solid roof over the central pane, new windshield crossbars, greenhouse canopy, shortened or swollen cockpit. Preserve surrounding angular shell and long narrow nose. The same cabin scale across the family. Selected B04's stylized glass does not override native cabin geometry.

EXACT FAMILY TOPOLOGY:
FIGHTER is low, one upper fuselage, one pair of broad angular main wings with stepped recessed saddles, exactly ONE centerline aft engine.
ELITE retains B04's same upper fuselage, tall central structural web and lower gondola, upper and lower wing pairs, exactly TWO aft engines: ONE at the rear of the UPPER fuselage and ONE at the rear of the LOWER gondola. Both on the longitudinal center plane, widely separated vertically by the central web. NO extra nozzle immediately below the upper engine. In old B04 that dark upper-fuselage underside patch is a closed service recess, not a third engine.
VHEAVY retains B04's provisional configuration: like elite with two thick angular side enclosures enclosing TWO large empty side openings, not glass windows. Exactly TWO engines in the same upper/lower arrangement as elite. Same approximate length, height and cabin size as elite, only modestly wider. Do not redesign its tentative silhouette or make it a capital ship; this is a documentation view, not final model approval.
Exhausts are broad dark recessed rectangular/trapezoidal throats within solid stepped housings. No blue windows on exhaust faces, no flames, no added thrusters. Give the rear the same large/medium stepped planes and backed service recesses as B04, not a different faction's design. All vents have inner walls/backing; no pipes or open trusses.
All ships in EXTENDED FLIGHT configuration, cargo doors closed. Wings retract linearly inward on short enclosed sliding saddles; they do NOT rotate like airplane folding wings. Fighter has two sliding sections, elite/vheavy four. Preserve visible seams separating moving side sections from fixed lower gondola. Behind the cockpit keep the two upper cargo-door leaves free of permanent structures; native opening is outward/upward about longitudinal axes, not a bottom hatch. No animation arrows or invented poses in this sheet.
Use ONE coherent construction per row in all views. Equipment is limited to existing B04 small native pads; no embedded weapon barrels or random additional mounts. Fine fasteners stay texture. Angular planes and clear recess depth take priority over tiny surface detail.

INPUT ROLES, IN ORDER:
1. Original B04 is the PRIMARY whole-family design authority.
2. Original textured cabin, immutable for every member.
3. Same native cabin in plain grey, clarifying its true shell and glass outlines.
4. Actual native ELITE structure: authority ONLY for upper/lower TWO-engine topology, vertical web, lower gondola and moving-part relationships. Do not revert B04 hull shapes to the older plain mesh.

SHEET A: title "BW B04 / FRONT - SIDE - TOP". Portrait concept board matching B04's layout and readable neutral pale paper, without decorative border. Three rows: FIGHTER at top, ELITE in middle, VHEAVY bottom. Each row has a LARGE FRONT 3/4 on the left, and smaller SIDE above TOP on the right. Full uncropped ship in every drawing, comparable cabin scale across classes. Noses point LEFT in side/top; front 3/4 is the original B04 direction. This sheet faithfully clarifies the SELECTED front and plan forms, restoring the native cabin and removing only the spurious third upper nozzle from elite/vheavy. Do not change B04 to a new design. Top views MUST show the elongated blue central cabin pane running up its crown. Keep the flight wing extension, thick enclosed roots, body cutouts and lower sections consistent across views. Label rows and view names clearly.

SHEET B: title "BW B04 / REAR - UNDERSIDE".
Portrait board with the same paper, row heights, relative cabin/ship scale, labels and rendering as sheet A. Three horizontal rows FIGHTER, ELITE, VHEAVY. Each row: LARGE full-ship REAR 3/4 at LEFT; smaller true straight REAR at UPPER RIGHT; true orthographic BOTTOM at LOWER RIGHT.

Same selected B04 silhouettes seen from the reverse side.

No side-by-side engines, stacked duplicate upper outlets, glowing blue windows or extra thrusters. Four flight wing sections in the heavy rows. VHEAVY's large left/right openings stay visibly EMPTY, surrounded by its existing solid faceted side shell, no new braces.
BOTTOM means genuinely seen FROM UNDERNEATH, with nose pointing UP and exhaust end DOWN. Show belly skin, underside stepped recesses, undersides of wing saddles and lower gondola belly. NO BLUE COCKPIT GLASS visible on the belly. Do not copy the TOP plan and label it BOTTOM. In heavy rows the low gondola naturally hides part of the central web in this projection; keep the same wing and side-enclosure plan outline.
Complete only the unshown rear/underside surfaces in B04's restrained angular mechanical language: simple recessed center engine sockets, closed stepped shoulder backs, modest service panels on the rear web and underside. No change to silhouette, length, scale, cabin, front side, wing placement, upper cargo doors or existing main cutouts. Do not add a new design feature merely to fill unseen surfaces. Exact rear geometry is a proposed continuation of the chosen art, not a different variant.
Labels only title, member names and REAR 3/4 / REAR / BOTTOM. Keep every ship uncropped with space around it.
